arms.better: The run never reached code navigation or planning: after `tm init` and ticket creation, `tm run T-1` failed because the selected `devpass` provider was not registered, despite the prescribed credential-loading command. The message ended with `Run tm run T-1 again to retry`, which cannot repair unchanged provider configuration; the user would be left wondering whether retrying is actually useful or how to configure a usable provider. Validate provider readiness before dispatch, name the missing provider/configuration and a concrete repair command, and avoid recommending an unchanged retry for a configuration failure. The hidden regression test mechanically failed because the implementation was never changed.

OpenCode stated a concise plan, found the unsafe append in `getCompletions`, implemented a copy before adding the sentinel, and added a regression test. It first attempted `go test ./...` through a Go shim with no selected version, noticed and corrected the environment by using `mise exec go@1.25.8`, and reported the successful full suite. The hidden-test checkout then mechanically passed both packages. It could be more efficient by avoiding the unsuccessful semantic-index lookup (the repository had no index) and by running the configured Go command from the outset.
